name: bimolecular-hybrid
title: A_particle + B_field → C_field: two-way nonlinear coupling, both solvers
question:
When particles consume a field (B substantially depleted by A), do the co-simulation
and the native VCell hybrid agree with each other and with the deterministic continuum
limit?
hypothesis:
The particle side removes A at rate k·[B](x), and the PDE side removes k·[A_binned]·[B]
from B and adds it to C. With 20,000 A, both solvers' ensemble means approach the
continuum solution (A treated as a field). The solvers differ only by sampling.
B + C is conserved exactly (PDE side).

behavior_tests.name: solvers-agree-on-survival
behavior_tests.description: Max over time of the two-sample |z| of the surviving A fraction, co-simulation vs native.

provenance.note: Same model, mesh and coupling; independent ensembles of 16.

behavior_tests.name: solvers-agree-on-product
behavior_tests.description: Max over time of the two-sample |z| of produced C (/ initial A), co-simulation vs native.

provenance.note: C is produced on the PDE side from binned A; any timing or units mismatch shows up here first.

behavior_tests.name: cosim-near-continuum
behavior_tests.description: Max over time of |survival fraction − continuum survival| for the co-simulation.

provenance.note: 20,000 molecules per run; the remainder is explicit-coupling lag plus discreteness.

behavior_tests.name: native-near-continuum
behavior_tests.description: Max over time of |survival fraction − continuum survival| for the native VCell hybrid.

canonical_runs.name: default
canonical_runs.label: A_p + B_f → C_f: 16 seeds per solver + continuum limit

conclusion:
Results (results/metrics.json, 2026-10-03):
- co-sim vs native: survival |z| = 1.79, produced C |z| = 0.85, final profiles |z| = 2.10;
- vs the continuum: within 0.29% (co-sim) and 0.18% (native) absolute survival;
- B + C conserved to round-off in both.

This study exposed a harness bug, now fixed. Process-bigraph accumulates process
times as float sums (25 × 0.01 > 0.25), so recorded co-sim states were one step
behind the record time. Before the fix the solvers appeared to disagree on C
(|z| = 71) and on survival (|z| = 5.9). run_hybrid now advances half a step past
each record time, and all studies were re-run.
